avoid_rewriting_existing_evidence: A new uniquely named supplemental batch with manifest and remote verification receipt is appended; older frozen packages remain unchanged.
binary_attempt_artifacts: May instead remain in a separately named remote supplemental proof-object tar archive, pinned by SHA/member manifest; no acceptance status. Never add large binary proof objects to Git.
direct_storage: Original UTF-8 text below the strict limit is copied byte-for-byte. All larger files and binary files use lossless parts.
encoding: RFC4648 standard base64; each part may be wrapped at76ASCII characters with LF; decode ignoring only ASCII whitespace.
large_indexes: If an index itself reaches the strict limit, split it using the same byte-preserving format and retain a small top-level index of ordered parts.
verification: Verify each stored/decoded part; require contiguous offsets with no gaps/overlaps; concatenate decoded parts in index order; require exact original total bytes and SHA256. Retain actual reconstructed verification receipt.
